tbesh_html:
1) to distract, ring again, make a (great) noise, murmur, roar, discomfit, be moved
1a) (Qal) to discomfit
1b) (Niphal) to be in a stir
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to murmur
1c2) to show disquietude

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to make an uproar, or agitate greatly
strongs_1890.kjv_def: destroy, move, make a noise, put, ring again.
